queries: GPT-5 GPT-3.5 benchmark comparison 2025 intelligence index

sources_considered.why: Versioned independent comparison incorporating earlier GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 baselines under aligned protocols.
Dated developer evaluations report gains across practical capability domains.
The October revision was available before the post and changes the benchmark scope and aggregate figures; the assessment uses that revision.
A changing comparison page is less suitable than a dated, versioned study for this historical assessment.

evidence_items.locator: Results, Overall performance across core BioNLP tasks; Figure 1
evidence_items.explanation: The study incorporates historical GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 results using aligned prompts, decoding and dataset partitions, and reports stronger overall GPT-5 performance. Individual tasks still favor other models or specialized systems.

evidence_items.locator: Building a more robust, reliable, and helpful model; Evaluations
evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI reports improved factuality alongside stronger coding, mathematical, multimodal and health performance. These developer results corroborate practical capability gains but are not a controlled workplace-productivity comparison with the original ChatGPT.

unresolved_gaps: The independent study uses historical GPT-3.5 baselines rather than rerunning the exact launch-day ChatGPT system.
These evaluations do not establish that every user or deployment obtains higher productivity.
